item.text: {"groups":[{"member_ids":["5734f7dc7782c298cd5a"],"operation":"Exercise ucl_parser_free on a saved, unattached comment after a parse error.","condition":"ucl_parser_add_string parses a line comment followed by an unterminated quoted key.","capability":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput must create the parser with UCL_PARSER_SAVE_COMMENTS and call ucl_parser_free on the error path.","consequence":"The saved-comment cleanup in ucl_parser_free is not exercised.","equivalence_reason":"This targets configuration and reachability of the saved-comment cleanup."},{"member_ids":["6cc38721c672e5259f85"],"operation":"Free the parser created by LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput after malformed input.","condition":"ucl_parser_get_error reports a parse error.","capability":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput must call ucl_parser_free before returning on the error path.","consequence":"The parser and its owned state remain allocated.","equivalence_reason":"This targets an existing parser leak on the error path, distinct from exercising saved-comment cleanup."}]}
